content: An important aspect of the active learning process is when to stop the active learning process. Stopping methods enable the potential benefits of active learning to be achieved in practice. Without stopping methods, the active learning process would continue until all annotations have been labeled, defeating the purpose of using active learning. Accordingly, there has been a lot of interest in the development of active learning stopping methods BIBREF2 , BIBREF3 , BIBREF4 , BIBREF5 , BIBREF6 .
